page_title: MET 2-1 NIC | Metz v Nice 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) comes onto the pitch for Alpha Toure.
90+3' Stephane Le Mignan prepares a substitution. Gauthier Hein is replaced by Cleo Melieres (Metz).
90+2' Melvin Bard (Nice) receives a yellow card.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The Nice players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Stephanie Frappart. NO PENALTY!
90' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Nice using VAR. Let's see what happens.
89' Handball by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz). It's a penalty for Nice!
88' Habib Diallo (Metz) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Joel Asoro.
87' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Gauthier Hein (Metz) for his blatant foul.
86' A substitution has been made. Antoine Mendy goes off and Tiago Gouveia (Nice) comes on.

84' 2 - 1 Habib Diallo (Metz) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Yehvann Diouf is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 2:1.
83' Terem Moffi (Nice) commits a foul and Stephanie Frappart immediately signals a free kick.
83' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
83' A lofted cross from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. It will be a corner kick for Nice.
79' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Sofiane Diop will be replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).
79' Terem Moffi (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mohamed-Ali Cho.
78' Gauthier Hein (Metz) launches a cross from the corner, but Yehvann Diouf is alert to thwart the effort.
78' Gauthier Hein (Metz) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play and Metz manage to earn a corner.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cheikh Sabaly trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
77' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to make a change. Boubacar Traore (Metz) replaces Jessy Deminguet.
74' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
74' Yellow card. Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
71' Substitution. Jeremie Boga (Nice) has come on for Kevin.
69' A long pass finds Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
66' A pass by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
63' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
61' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
61' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
60' Chance! Kevin (Nice) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
57' Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to intercept the corner from Gauthier Hein (Metz).

57' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play. Metz will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gauthier Hein (Metz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Gauthier Hein (Metz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yehvann Diouf into right side of the goal.
53' Gauthier Hein (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' Juma Bah (Nice) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
52' It’s a PENALTY to Metz after the VAR review!
52' Referee Stephanie Frappart makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Metz. Let’s see what happens!
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Nice players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' A wild effort from Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
50' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Gauthier Hein (Metz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
47' Franck Haise makes a switch. Melvin Bard (Nice) is coming on in place of Ali Abdi at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
41' Half-chance! Jonathan Clauss (Nice) plays a pass into the box, but Jonathan Fischer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
38' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
35' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) was set free in the area by Charles Vanhoutte and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top left corner. 0:1.
33' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
33' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
27' Ali Abdi (Nice) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
25' 3:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
21' Antoine Mendy (Nice) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
19' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
18' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yehvann Diouf is quickest to intercept the ball.
16' The resulting corner, taken by Gauthier Hein (Metz), comes to nothing.
15' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jonathan Fischer intercepts the ball.
14' Kevin (Nice) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
10' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
9' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
7' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
5' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
3' Alpha Toure (Metz) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
3' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Metz win a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Nice will kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
